name: ai-qa-assistant
description: Production-grade AI QA Assistant for generating test cases, bug reports, Jira worklogs, and QA matrices with Google Gemini and Groq.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && node scripts/copy-dist.js
